title: When LLM Therapists Become Salespeople: Evaluating Large Language Models for Ethical Motivational Interviewing
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the ethical awareness of Large Language Models regarding Motivational Interviewing (MI), particularly in unethical sales contexts.

measurement_description: The paper mentions 'religion' as a social factor that can cause bias in LLMs for mental health predictions, but this is a citation of another study (Wang et al., 2024b) in the related works section. The benchmark and experiments conducted in this paper do not measure any aspect of faith or religion; they focus on the ethical application of Motivational Interviewing in sales contexts.
